label: D2 a1->S1 common, larger with belief S1 good, after a1 S2 u, late episode
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * ~((action == 1) & (state == 1)) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * np.clip(belief_lo,0,5) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 1) * belief_cover
explanation: Fires only at D2, and essentially only when a1 has just led commonly to S1 (all other D2 outcomes sit below the timing baseline; D1/GO are always 0). Within a1->S1 D2 steps the magnitude grows with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good (positive log-odds, clipped 0-5), with episode decile (+0.04 per decile), and is strongly boosted (+0.33) when the previous trial was a1 -> S2 unrewarded, i.e. a rare unrewarded trial that a model-based agent stays after. It is lower after a1 S1 unrewarded (-0.09) and on switch trials coming from a2 (-0.15); prev_reward alone adds nothing. Only observed quantities used (this trial choice and state are known at D2). Test R^2 beyond timing 0.40 (dev 0.42), vs all-observed reference 0.32 and the all ceiling 0.43 (which includes the model policy, reference 0.27 alone); so dropping the model value/policy loses little. Remaining error: overprediction on some a1 S1 trials after a2 S1 r / a1 S2 r histories and underprediction of the peak (~1.4) during long confident a1 streaks late in an episode.
